# streamtime Provider

Manage Streamtime resources. Every value can be left out and set through the environment or the Streamtime CLI login instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    streamtime = {
      source = "streamtime-ai/streamtime"
    }
  }
}

# Every value can come from the environment (STREAMTIME_API_URL,
# STREAMTIME_ORG, STREAMTIME_API_KEY) or your Streamtime CLI login instead.
provider "streamtime" {
  api_url      = "https://api.example.com"
  organization = "acme"
  api_key      = var.streamtime_api_key
}

variable "streamtime_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key. Environment: STREAMTIME_API_KEY. Use this in CI and for long runs.
- `api_url` (String) Address of your Streamtime installation, for example https://api.example.com. Environment: STREAMTIME_API_URL. There is no default.
- `ca_cert_file` (String) Path to a PEM file with the certificate authority that signed the Streamtime certificate.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification. Environment: STREAMTIME_VERIFY_SSL=false. Only for throwaway environments.
- `organization` (String) Organization identifier. Environment: STREAMTIME_ORG.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Login token. Environment: STREAMTIME_TOKEN. It expires; run 'streamtime login' again when it does. Set either api_key or token, not both.
